items.title: Northrop Grumman (NOC) Will Not Protest Its F A XX Loss
items.summary: Northrop Grumman (NYSE:NOC) has chosen not to protest the U.S. Navy's F/A-XX fighter award to Boeing. The decision follows the Navy's selection of Boeing for the next-generation carrier-based fighter contract, a flagship combat aircraft program. By forgoing a protest, Northrop Grumman leaves the current F/A-XX award structure in place without seeking a formal review process. Northrop Grumman's choice to accept the F/A-XX outcome shapes how our wider research views its role in future combat...
